test_objective: Check that a notification is sent with flat linked entity in simplified format when linking entity is updated
keywords: Create Initial Subscription And Entity With Linked Entity
Delete Initial Subscription And Entity With Linked Entity

test_cases.name: 046_25_01 Check that a notification is sent with flat linked entity in simplified format
test_cases.doc: Create an attribute in linking entity and check the notification contains linked entity in simplified format
test_cases.setup: Create Initial Subscription And Entity With Linked Entity
test_cases.teardown: Delete Initial Subscription And Entity With Linked Entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${linking_entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'name-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
